rich_narrative.summary: AL Ummah Community Center (AUCC) is a New Jersey-based nonprofit established in <cite id="1">2018</cite> to provide community services based on Islamic principles. The organization operates a variety of local and international initiatives, including the <cite id="2">Ummah's Kitchen Food Pantry</cite> and youth programs. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="3">total revenue of $464,660</cite>, which represents a significant <cite id="4">67% decline from the $1,415,881 reported in FY2023</cite>. Despite this contraction in funding, the charity maintains a <cite id="5">program expense ratio of 82.3%</cite> based on its most recent comprehensive financial filings. AUCC focuses on direct service delivery, particularly in food security and religious cultural support. The organization holds an <cite id="6">overall score of 71.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting a balanced profile of accountability and leadership. While the charity serves underserved populations, donors should note that <cite id="7">data confidence is low</cite> due to limited third-party impact reporting and transparency gaps. The charity's operations extend beyond its local base to include <cite id="8">global water campaigns and orphan sponsorship</cite> in regions such as Palestine, Kenya, and Syria.
